title: Exceptional, no nonsense app
body:
Sensational organisation app. The minimalism is absolutely perfect for people who actually want to track their habits without the faff. My ADHD makes organisation challenging and over the year I’ve tried countless apps that claim to help “neurodivergent people” or be “perfect for those who procrastinate.” They end up being made for quick cash grabs or having a wildly confusing interface that is overwhelming and challenging to navigate. 

With Dots, you get exactly what you download. All your habits trackable in a range of formats (card, list, calendar form) so you can check them off in the one you prefer. You can also add the widget to your home screen so you can cross habits off during the day without having to open the app. There’s no paywall, no ads, and it’s beautifully minimalistic. Everything I needed I am so thankful that I found this.
author: fayeflame

title: Near perfect
body:
Fantastic app. Visually slick, simple to use and free with no ad distractions etc..

Only missing feature would be to incorporate some sort of notes/comments section for your habits to help track progress.
author: Mat Spence

title: Free & functional !
body: No obnoxious free-trial trick. Actually free, easy to use & aesthetically pleasing. It didn’t have options for reminders & shuffling the order of your habits, but it does now! -Even more happy with it. Truly a perfect simple little app.

title: Great app
body: Absolutely the best app out there. Absolutely free to use. Love this.

title: Great and simple app but
body: I wish there was a feature to go back one day or two to tick my task as done, because sometimes i forget to tick it, and it already gets to the next dah and no option to go back and tick it.

title: Great app

title: Great daily but no weekly
body: I love the daily tracking for free with no “premium” version, but I feel like we need a weekly/monthly/select days option!

body: Does what it says in the best, lean and minimalist way possible. UX designer gets a big shout out.
